# Pull request checklist

## Summary

Describe the customer-facing or operational change in clear, claim-safe language.

## Required review

- [ ] Public copy contains no unsupported savings, payback, certification, or performance claims.
- [ ] All concept imagery is labelled as illustrative where applicable.
- [ ] Keyboard, mobile, and reduced-motion paths have been considered.
- [ ] Relevant tests and the production build have passed.

## Requested marker

`**`
